messages:
ashok: Heads-up — bringing up a community model and hit a weird mismatch between tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json during HF -> Redwood conversion. fast tokenizer picks up tokenizer.json, slow loader uses tokenizer_config.json and ends up with missing <|pad|> and custom specials.

devon: ugh, seen that. are both files present in the repo for that model?

ashok: yes. repo has both. tokenizer.json contains the full merges + special_tokens, tokenizer_config.json only has a minimal mapping. fast picks tokenizer.json and works; when we run the slow path (for CPU-quant tests) it falls back to tokenizer_config.json and drops the custom specials. Repro steps:

```
# from model dir
ls -1
- config.json
- tokenizer.json
- tokenizer_config.json
- merges.txt
- vocab.json

# loader call
python -c "from redwood.tokenizers import load_tokenizer; print(load_tokenizer('path/to/model'))"
```

maria: do we know which code path determines priority? fast tokenizer loader uses tokenizer.json if present; slow HF loader reads tokenizer_config.json and builds slow tokenizer from that. mismatch happens when tokenizer_config.json lacks `special_tokens_map` entries.

ashok: exactly. this caused a quality regression in the quantized run earlier — prompts that used a custom delimiter started getting tokenized differently. Eval numbers: baseline (hosted fast) perplexity 12.1, slow-quantized run perplexity 15.8 on our small prompt suite.

eval-bot: alert: regression detected on bringup-2026-03: +30% perplexity vs hosted baseline on delimiter-sensitive prompts.

devon: immediate mitigation: copy over specials into tokenizer_config.json during conversion, or force slow loader to consult tokenizer.json when available. which is easier?

maria: quick patch: conversion script (tools/hf_to_redwood.py) can merge special tokens from tokenizer.json into tokenizer_config.json. I'll sketch a diff.

ashok: can we also add a unit test to catch this? minimal: drop tokenizer.json and verify slow loader still has specials after conversion.

maria: yup. test plan: add sample model fixture with both files; run conversion; assert special tokens present in loaded tokenizer: `assert tok.convert_tokens_to_ids(['<|pad|>','<|sep|>'])`

devon: note: need to be careful with token id collisions when merging — tokenizer.json may carry different vocab ordering. prefer to add missing specials as new tokens if absent, but if ids exist we should keep original.

ashok: good call. for quant path we also saw KV-cache shape differences because special token presence changed tokenization length. that cascaded into runtime errors for the quantized kernels.

maria: i'll open a PR that: 1) updates conversion to merge specials from tokenizer.json -> tokenizer_config.json, 2) adds fast/slow parity test, 3) documents precedence.

devon: can you add a small integration test that runs a 5-prompt eval and compares token counts? that would catch length drift early.

maria: yeah, add `tests/integration/tokenizer_parity.py` with a 5 prompt smoke check. will stub heavy evals out.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: conversion-script patch queued to staging on merge.

ashok: also flagging for release notes: "HF conversion: prefer tokenizer.json specials; merge into tokenizer_config to avoid slow-loader missing tokens."

devon: one more wrinkle — some HF models only include tokenizer_config.json (no tokenizer.json). conversion should be idempotent and not require tokenizer.json. merge should be conditional.

maria: yep will implement safe-merge: if tokenizer.json exists, merge specials; otherwise leave tokenizer_config as-is.

ashok: thanks. after PR lands we'll re-run quantized evals and check the perplexity/regression. ping me on the thread when staging passes. :thumbsup:

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tools/pull/789 (WIP) — tests added, working on idempotency adjustments.

devon: great. if staging shows parity, we'll mark the bring-up as unblocked.

eval-bot: note: will re-run scheduled eval 02:00 UTC after merge.

ashok: sweet — appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria: will update here once green.

devon: TY!

maria: (added NOTE in PR: we should also log which tokenizer file was used at load time: `INFO Loaded tokenizer from tokenizer.json` or `tokenizer_config.json` so future debugging is easier.)

ashok: agreed. tiny logging change helps a lot.

maria: done in PR. merging after one more review.

deploy-bot: PR merged and staged.

ashok: re-run results queued.

eval-bot: rerun complete: perplexity now 12.3 vs baseline 12.1 on the small prompt suite. regression mostly fixed. closing alert. :white_check_mark:
